gloss: thinking ability; intellectual capacity; power of thought

definitions.gloss: thinking ability; intellectual capacity; power of thought
definitions.explanation: The ability to think logically, critically, and creatively. Often discussed in education and professional development as a skill to be cultivated.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{思考力|しこうりょく}を{育|そだ}てる。
この{問題|もんだい}は{思考力|しこうりょく}が{試|ため}される。
examples.english: This problem tests your thinking ability.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}は{思考力|しこうりょく}を{高|たか}めるのに{役立|やくだ}つ。
examples.english: Reading is helpful for improving one's thinking ability.

examples.japanese: AIの{時代|じだい}こそ、{人間|にんげん}の{思考力|しこうりょく}が{重要|じゅうよう}になる。
examples.english: It is precisely in the age of AI that human thinking ability becomes important.

notes:
A buzzword in Japanese education, where 思考力 is one of the key competencies emphasized in curriculum reforms. Part of the productive ～力 (りょく) pattern meaning 'the power/ability to do X.' Frequently discussed alongside 判断力 (judgment) and 表現力 (expressive ability).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思考力|しこうりょく}を{高|たか}める: to enhance thinking ability
- {思考力|しこうりょく}を{鍛|きた}える: to train one's thinking
- {思考力|しこうりょく}・{判断力|はんだんりょく}・{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}: thinking, judgment, and expression (education triad)
- {論理的|ろんりてき}{思考力|しこうりょく}: logical thinking ability
- {批判的|ひはんてき}{思考力|しこうりょく}: critical thinking ability

RELATED ～力 COMPOUNDS:
- {判断力|はんだんりょく}: judgment; ability to judge
- {集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}: concentration; ability to focus
- {想像力|そうぞうりょく}: imagination
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}: expressive ability
